item.title: Kongobu-ji: Head Temple of Shingon Buddhism — Guide
item.description: Kongobu-ji is the head temple of the Koyasan Shingon sect and the administrative centre of the whole mountain, its wide cypress-roofed halls set behind a handsome gate in the middle of the temple town. Inside, a series of chambers is lined with beautiful gold-leaf fusuma sliding screens painted with cranes, willows and the life of Kobo Daishi, including the sombre Willow Room where the warlord Toyotomi Hidetsugu was ordered to commit ritual suicide in 1595.
